title: With cacheComponents, dropdowns stay open and forms keep old values after navigating away and back
symptoms: A popover opened before navigation is still open on return
useActionState success messages and input values persist after leaving the page
Mount-time logic such as opening a dialog from a query param does not run again
E2E tests that relied on a fresh page state start failing
cause: With cacheComponents, the router keeps visited routes in a hidden React Activity instead of unmounting them. useState, form inputs and scroll survive the round trip.
fix: Add explicit resets: close popovers in a useLayoutEffect cleanup, derive dialog open state from the URL, and reset forms in the submit handler.
